reviews.text: Randy Topham is the BEST stylist. I’ve never gotten a hair cut that I haven’t loved. He does everything, wedding hair, cut, color, and it’s perfect every time. Don’t go somewhere else, go to him. He’s fantastic
Came in for an impulsive last minute cut - Nikki was available and KILLED IT! Im obsessed and it was fun watching her geek out and get excited while cutting it too 🥰

Wow. I’ve been searching long and hard for a great stylist to clean up my blonde highlights, and Jonesy totally took my breath away. Amazing technique, so much time and effort, and great conversation. Already booked with them again!
